verdict.rationale: Neon documents natural-language operation of its databases through its official hosted MCP server. That server exposes a 113-tool surface covering SQL, schema migrations, and project and branch lifecycle, and probes confirm it is live and OAuth-gated with schema-typed tools. The SQL Editor also has AI-assisted SQL generation. missing for 10: a first-party natural-language interface for platform operations (the language understanding comes from a third-party MCP client, and `neon ask` only answers documentation questions), and independent hands-on corroboration of end-to-end natural-language task execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Connect MCP clients to the Neon MCP Server to interact with your Lakebase Postgres databases in natural language.
The hosted Neon MCP Server exposes a 113-tool surface ("Tools preview: 113 enabled") spanning the whole platform
The Neon SQL Editor includes AI-powered features to assist with writing, optimizing, and generating names for SQL queries.
